name: Character Advancement
content:
In Renaissance, characters gain experience by making mistakes and overcoming adversity. This experience is represented mechanically by Experience Points (XP):

GAINING EXPERIENCE

There are five ways characters can gain XP:

  • Every time a character fails a Skill Check or loses an Opposed Skill Check, they gain 1 XP. 

  • Every time the GM takes a Soft Move, all members of the Quest gain 1 XP.

  • Every time the GM takes a Hard Move, all members of the Quest gain 5 XP.

  • If a player character dies during the Quest, all surviving members gain 10 XP.

XP is gained immediately, in the moment the triggering event occurs.

If a character makes repeated failed attempts of the same Skill Check to accomplish the same task (e.g. rolling Strength several times in a row to break down a door) it does not award additional XP for additional failures - you only gain XP from the initial failure.

If a player accepts a Pass/Win With Complication on a Skill Check (see Dice Rolls), they do not gain XP from their initial failure.

A NOTE ABOUT FAILURE

Players may, of course, choose actions they are likely to fail in order to “farm” XP. In Renaissance, this is not inherently a problem—growth comes through failure, and failure often makes for better stories. However, the potential for abuse exists.

As a first guardrail, the GM should ensure that characters face meaningful consequences for their choices as events unfold in the game. If a player begins engaging the mechanics of the game in a way that undermines the narrative or the group’s shared experience, pause the game and have an above-the-table discussion to establish a group consensus about expectations before continuing.

SPENDING EXPERIENCE

You can spend XP to improve your character in two ways:

  • Spend 30 XP to increase a Core Stat score by 1. Doing so also allows you to add one rank to any Skill under that Core Stat and recalculate the maximum for the Virtue under that Core Stat. When you increase a Virtue maximum in this way, also increase the current value for that Virtue by the same amount.

  • Spend XP to gain new Abilities from your Mestiere. Costs vary and are listed on each Ability.

You can spend XP as a Free Action at any time during gameplay - even in the middle of a tense or complicated moment - and your character has immediate access to their new Abilities or improved stats.

It’s up to you to choose the moment when your character makes a leap forward in their abilities. When youspends XP, describe what has pushed your character to the next level in that moment.
